info.title: Symphony Runtime API
info.description: Local orchestration runtime API used by Symphony Desktop, the mobile companion and local tools.

get.description:
Sends `ready` on connect. When the client reconnects with `Last-Event-ID`, persisted events
newer than that id are replayed first; if the id is unknown (or the broadcast buffer
overflowed) a `resync` event tells the client to refetch its state.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this event id; persisted events newer than it are replayed first.

200.description: Server-Sent Events. `ready`/`resync` carry a `StreamControlEvent`; every other event is an `AgentEvent` named by its `event_type` with `id` = event id.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/events/recent?limit=N` — persisted events across all tasks, newest first.

200.description: The task, dispatched with the instructions; 409 while it runs

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Return only events older than this event id of the same task (the oldest event of the
previous page); omit for the newest events.

200.description: Newest first; 404 when `before` is not an event of this task

get.summary:
A task's tool-call history (shell commands, file changes, MCP and host tools), newest first.
Arguments and output are redacted and output is capped at 64 KiB per call. Local only: tool
output can carry workspace content, like the task diff.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tool calls (1–500, default 200).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Return only calls older than this tool-call id of the same task (the oldest call of the
previous page); omit for the newest calls.

200.description: Newest first; 404 when `before` is not a tool call of this task

post.summary:
Publish a reviewed branch as a GitHub pull request: commits the worktree's changes to the task
branch, pushes it to `origin` (never forced) and opens a pull request into the base branch.
An explicit human action, local administration only. Nothing is merged. Repeating the call
returns the review's existing pull request.

Refresh a review's pull request from GitHub: CI result, merge state, state and review comments,
then re-rate it. Read-only on GitHub; local administration only.

200.description: git, Graphify and Serena: what is installed and how to install the rest

202.description: Indexing started; progress and the result arrive as `knowledge/index_*` events

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Scope the `files` level to this module.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Node the `symbols` level is centred on.

parameters.name: include_external
parameters.description: Include external dependencies in the `modules` level (default false).

200.description: A bounded view of the code graph; `truncated` says when it was cut
Files and symbols whose name or path matches, best first
What the node uses, what uses it, what it contains and its recent commits
Precise references from the optional language-server navigator; `available` is false, with a reason, when it cannot answer. The first request per indexed commit can take a minute.
Every git worktree of the repository, with its HEAD, uncommitted changes and owning task
One row per commit across all worktrees, newest first

parameters.name: sha
parameters.description: Commit id (7 to 64 lowercase hex digits)

200.description: The symbols the commit touched and the code that depends on them

202.description: The cached analysis, or a running one that finishes with a `knowledge/analysis_completed` event
The question and the answer being produced (`status = running`); it completes with a `knowledge/chat_completed` event

post.summary:
Validates and renders unsaved workflow text. Always `200`; invalid documents are reported
through `valid: false` + `error` so editors can show inline diagnostics.

Create a backup now: a transactionally consistent copy of the database (SQLite `VACUUM INTO`,
WAL included) plus the active `WORKFLOW.md`, with a checksum manifest. Credentials are not
included. Restoring is an offline operation (`symphony-cli restore-backup <folder>`).

get.summary: Persisted remote-access settings together with the listener's effective state.

post.summary:
Generate a new remote access token (256 random bits), replacing any previous one. The token
is returned once and cannot be read back; open remote sessions using the old token end.

delete.summary: Revoke the remote access token and stop the remote listener.

depth.description: Hops from the nearest changed node.

via_relation.description: The relation of the last hop (for example `calls`).

from_node_id.description: The node it was reached from.

confidence.description: The weakest edge on the path.

AgentEvent.description: Structured agent/orchestrator event emitted in real time and stored in SQLite

evidence.description: Ids from `CommitAnalysis::evidence`; never empty after validation.

AppSettings.description:
Application settings persisted in SQLite (non-secret).

`#[serde(default)]` keeps previously persisted JSON readable when fields are added:
missing keys fall back to `AppSettings::default()` instead of failing deserialization.

oneOf.description:
Agent used for CodeSandbox cloud runs when a task does not pick one. `None` (never chosen)
defers to `codesandbox.default_agent` in `WORKFLOW.md`, which is mini-swe-agent unless the
workflow says otherwise. Omit it to keep the stored value.

remote_allowed_origins.description:
Browser origins (besides the companion app) allowed to call the remote listener, e.g. a
self-hosted companion at `https://companion.example.com`. Never `*`.

provider_default_models.description: Per-provider default model preference (`ProviderKind` -> model id).

event_retention_days.description:
Days the activity log (agent events) of finished tasks is kept; older events are deleted.
`0` keeps everything. Events of tasks that are still active are never deleted.

Omit it (or send `null`) to leave the stored value unchanged; clients written before this
setting existed do exactly that. Settings that never had a value use 30.

backup_interval_hours.description:
Hours between automatic backups (`0` = no automatic backups). A backup of any kind newer
than this resets the clock. Omit it (or send `null`) to keep the stored value; settings that
never had a value use 24.

backup_keep.description:
How many automatic backups are kept (1–100); older automatic backups are deleted after each
new one. Backups made by hand are never deleted. Omit it to keep the stored value; settings
that never had a value use 7.

pr_refresh_interval_minutes.description:
Minutes between automatic status checks of open pull requests (CI, merge state, review
comments): `0` = only when asked (*Refresh status*), otherwise 5–1440 (1–4 are refused).
Omit it to keep the stored value; settings that never had a value use 15.

ApprovalRequest.description: Approval request raised by an agent session (e.g. command execution, file patch, PR creation, merge)

BackupList.description: Existing backups, newest first, and the directory they live in.

BackupSummary.description: One backup on disk. Credentials are never part of a backup.

path.description: Absolute directory of the backup on this machine.

schema_version.description: Database schema version of the backup.

includes_workflow.description: Whether the active `WORKFLOW.md` is part of the backup.

scheduled.description:
Made by the automatic schedule (`backup_interval_hours`); only these are deleted by its
retention (`backup_keep`).

BlockerRef.description: Blocker reference for an Issue (SPEC.md Section 4.1.1)

node_id.description: The node id in the index, when the symbol still exists there.

in_index.description: `node_id` was found in the indexed graph (otherwise the symbol is new or was removed since).

CloudAgentKind.description: Which agent runs inside a CodeSandbox cloud sandbox (`ProviderKind::CodeSandbox`).

CodeSandboxConfig.description: Settings for cloud agents that run in CodeSandbox microVMs.

template_id.description: Template id or alias built with `tools/codesandbox-runner/scripts/build-template.mjs`.

hibernation_timeout_secs.description: Seconds of inactivity before the sandbox hibernates.

cost_limit_usd.description: Spend limit for one mini-swe-agent run in USD; `0` disables the limit.

runner_path.description: Path of the compiled bridge (`dist/bridge.mjs`); `None` finds the bundled one.

evidence.description: Everything the model was allowed to cite.

dropped_findings.description: Findings the model produced that cited nothing the prompt contained; they are not shown.

oneOf.description: The newest analysis of the commit, or `null` when it has never been analysed.

diff_base.description: The commit the changes are relative to (the first parent); `None` for a root commit.

diff.description: Unified diff against the first parent, secrets redacted.

run_id.description: The index the affected set was computed on, if there is one.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the symbol-level part is missing, when it is.

symbol_files_skipped.description: Source files beyond the per-commit limit that were not looked at symbol by symbol.

unpushed.description:
Not on any remote-tracking ref. `None` when the repository has no remote refs at all, so
"unpushed" would be meaningless.

refs.description: Branches and tags pointing at this commit.

worktrees.description: Every worktree whose HEAD history contains this commit; one entry per worktree, one row per SHA.

is_head.description: The commit is this worktree's HEAD (not just in its history).

Confidence.description:
How the engine came to an edge. `Extracted` was read from the source; the other two are
inferred, and the UI draws them differently.

ContinueTaskRequest.description: Operator instructions that continue a task's agent thread (`POST /tasks/{id}/continue`).

instructions.description: What the agent should do next (1–20 000 characters).

oneOf.description:
Agent that runs in the sandbox for a `codesandbox` task (`mini_swe_agent`, `pi` or
`pi_durable`); omit it to use the default from settings.

auto_start.description:
Dispatch the task to an agent immediately after creation.
`dispatch_immediately` is accepted as an alias for older clients.

configured.description: Names of configured credentials. Values are never returned.

DiffHunk.description: A changed line range. Zero-length ranges are pure insertions (`new_lines == 0` is a deletion).

EngineStatus.description: A tool the Knowledge Base can use (`git`, `graphify`, `serena`).

required.description: What the Knowledge Base cannot do without it.

command.description: The executable that was found (or the configured command that was not).

install_hint.description: A command the user can run to install it; Symphony never installs anything itself.

detail.description: Why it is unavailable, or a licence/usage note.

EvidenceRef.description:
A piece of repository material the model was given and may cite. Only ids that were in the
prompt survive validation, so every citation resolves to something real.

line.description: Line of the occurrence (for example the call site) in the source node's file.

weight.description: For aggregated edges: how many underlying edges they stand for.

file.description: Repository-relative path, `None` for externals and aggregated modules.

module.description: The package or directory the node belongs to.

members.description: For aggregated nodes: how many underlying nodes they stand for.

focus.description: The module or node the view is centred on, when one was requested.

total_nodes.description: Counts before the size limit was applied.

HardwareSnapshot.description: Hardware & power telemetry snapshot (Section 13: ASUS Zephyrus G16 / Windows 11 aware)

HealthSignal.description: One observation about the repository or the index, each backed by a measured value.

unattributed_hunks.description: Changed lines that fall outside every known symbol (imports, constants, comments).

ref_name.description: The branch or worktree the indexed commit came from.

Issue.description: Normalized Issue record used across orchestration, prompting, and observability (SPEC.md Section 4.1.1)

default_branch_sha.description: The default branch tip right now.

oneOf.description: The newest completed index, if any.
An index that is running now, or the last one if it failed.

index_stale.description: The index is older than the commit it was built from's branch tip.

symbol_count.description: Types, functions and methods in the index (0 without an index).

KnowledgeWorktree.description: One git worktree of the repository (`git worktree list`), with live state.

id.description: Stable id derived from the path.

exists.description: The directory exists on disk (a prunable worktree may have been deleted).

ahead_of_default.description: Commits reachable from this worktree's HEAD that are not on the default branch.

LiveSession.description: Live session metadata tracked while an agent subprocess is active (SPEC.md Section 4.1.6)

LocalePreference.description:
Allowed values of [`AppSettings::locale`]. Documents the API contract only; the setting is
stored as a string and validated by the API layer.

score.description: Structured rating from 1 (blocked/critical issues) to 5 (ready to merge with full verification)

dependencies.description: What this node uses (outgoing dependency edges).

references.description: What uses this node (incoming dependency edges).

members.description: Members of a file / type (contained symbols).

recent_commits.description: Commits that touched the node's file, newest first (from git, not from the index).

OrchestratorStateSnapshot.description: SPEC.md Section 13.7.2 `/api/v1/state` response contract + Symphony Desktop extensions

Precision.description: How exactly a changed line range was mapped onto a symbol.

Project.description: Project entity representing a connected local + tracker repository

ProjectUpdate.description: Partial project update (`PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}`). Absent fields are left unchanged.

ProviderAuthState.description:
Authentication state of a provider CLI as observed by the runtime.

Detection only inspects the presence of credential files or environment variables; it never
reads or reports secret values. `Unknown` is used when credentials may live in an OS keychain
that the runtime does not probe.

ProviderCapabilities.description: Typed capabilities exposed by an agent provider (Section 6)

ProviderStatus.description: Runtime-detected status of a coding agent provider (`GET /api/v1/providers`).

auth_detail.description: Non-secret description of the credential source (e.g. "OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable").

PullRequestReview.description: Structured Pull Request Review & Merge-Readiness Rating (1 to 5 backed by evidence, Section 4.F)

reviewed_commit.description:
The commit Symphony pushed when it opened the pull request: what the local validation and
security evidence describe. A pull request whose head moved beyond it is flagged on refresh.

unpushed_changes.description:
Set on the review of a run that continued a task after its pull request was opened: that
work is not on the pull request until it is published. Reviews stored before this field
existed read as `false`, so an older published review is never mistaken for one.

RemoteAccessStatus.description: Remote access configuration (persisted settings) together with what is actually running.

allowed_origins.description: Browser origins allowed in addition to the companion app's own origin.

token_configured.description: Whether a remote access token exists. The token itself is never returned here.

listening_on.description: Address the listener is bound to while `state` is `running`.

RemoteListenerState.description: Effective state of the remote listener.

RemoteTokenIssued.description: Response of a token rotation: the new token, shown once.

token.description: New remote access token. Store it in the companion app now; it cannot be read back.

RepositoryValidation.description: Result of validating a local repository before project registration.

RetryEntry.description: Retry Entry in orchestrator state (SPEC.md Section 4.1.7)

usage_estimated.description: `true` when this attempt's token usage is an estimate (see `Task::usage_estimated`).

RuntimeInfo.description: Runtime identity used by clients to discover capabilities (`GET /api/v1/runtime`).

codesandbox.description: CodeSandbox cloud agent settings (`codesandbox:` front matter section).

force.description: Run again even when an analysis for this configuration is cached.

worktree_id.description: Index the HEAD of this worktree instead of the default branch.

StreamControlEvent.description: Payload of the `ready` and `resync` SSE events.

SymbolReference.description: One place that uses a symbol, as a language server reports it (Serena).

name_path.description: The symbol that contains the use, for example `impl Orchestrator/list_worktrees`.

start_line.description: Range of the containing symbol (1-based, inclusive).

reference_line.description: The line of the use itself.

snippet.description: A few lines around the use.

SymbolReferences.description: Precise references of a symbol from the optional language-server navigator.

available.description: `false` when the navigator could not answer; `reason` says why.

definition_start_line.description: The exact range of the definition (1-based, inclusive), including its doc comment.

Task.description: Task record persisted in SQLite and orchestrated by Symphony

oneOf.description:
Agent that runs in the sandbox when `provider` is `codesandbox`; `None` uses the default
from settings / `WORKFLOW.md` (mini-swe-agent).

Absolute usage of the provider thread (`current_thread_id`) that earlier attempts already
accounted for: the baseline a resumed thread's cumulative reports are measured against.

usage_estimated.description:
`true` when part of the token totals could not be measured exactly (the provider did not
expose enough information to separate this task's usage from a resumed thread's history).

TaskDiff.description: Changed files and unified diff for a task workspace (`GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/diff`).

TaskStatus.description: Symphony Desktop Kanban & Orchestration Task Statuses (Section 4.C & 5)

ThemePreference.description:
Allowed values of [`AppSettings::theme`]. Documents the API contract only; the setting is
stored as a string and validated by the API layer.

ThreadUsageMark.description: Absolute token usage of one provider thread, as last accounted for by Symphony.

ToolCallRecord.description:
One tool call of a task, as stored and served by `GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/tool-calls`.
Arguments and output are redacted before they are stored.

id.description: `"{task_id}:{call_id}"`, so the start and the result of a call land on one record.

output_truncated.description: The output was longer than 64 KiB and was cut.

WorkflowDocument.description: Workflow document as served to editors (`GET /api/v1/workflow`).

path.description: File the document is loaded from and saved to, if any.

oneOf.description: Parsed configuration with tracker credentials redacted.

WorkflowValidation.description: Result of previewing or saving a workflow document.

WorkingTreeChange.description: Uncommitted work of a worktree, shown next to the commits (it has no SHA).

WorktreeInfo.description: Git worktree allocated for a task (`GET /api/v1/worktrees`).

WorktreeTaskLink.description: The Symphony task that owns a worktree, when there is one.

bearer_auth.description: Per-launch token from the desktop host or `<data_dir>/runtime.json`
